title: Red Shift and the Expanding Universe - Check 2

questions.stem: How is red shift measured from distant galaxies?

options.text: By measuring the brightness of the galaxy
By counting the number of stars in the galaxy
By measuring the temperature of the galaxy
By comparing the observed absorption spectra with known laboratory spectra

questions.explanation: Red shift is measured by observing the absorption spectra of light from distant galaxies and comparing the positions of the spectral lines with those measured in a laboratory. The shift in the lines towards the red end indicates the galaxy is moving away.
